---
title: "rtfreporter: Development Summary Report and its attachments"
params:
  out: "out"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
out <- params$out
rd <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(out, f))) readRDS(file.path(out, f))
csv <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(out, f))) {
  utils::read.csv(file.path(out, f), colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
chk <- rd("check.rds")
cov <- rd("coverage.rds")
envs <- rd("environments.rds")
local_runs <- csv("local-runs.csv")
```

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
# page one: the Development Summary Report, as validation/trace.R wrote it
sm <- readLines(file.path(out, "summary.md"), encoding = "UTF-8")
cat(sm[-1L], sep = "\n")
gh <- Sys.getenv(c("GITHUB_SERVER_URL", "GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "GITHUB_RUN_ID"))
if (all(nzchar(gh))) {
  cat(sprintf("\nThis report: <%s/%s/actions/runs/%s>; the releases: <%s/%s/releases>.\n",
              gh[1], gh[2], gh[3], gh[1], gh[2]))
}
```

\newpage

# The CI validation report

What the tests ran on and with: every CI environment of this commit, the
package versions, R CMD check, the tests' log, line coverage and the tests that
run each exported function.

## A. R-CMD-check of this commit, every CI environment

```{r attach-a, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(envs) || !nrow(envs)) {
  cat("No R-CMD-check run was found for this commit (the report was made outside CI).")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(Environment = envs$environment, Result = envs$result,
                                Tests = envs$tests, Run = sprintf("<%s>", envs$url)),
                     row.names = FALSE))
}
if (!is.null(local_runs)) {
  cat("\n\nLocal runs (by hand):\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(local_runs, row.names = FALSE))
}
```

## B. This run's environment and package versions

```{r attach-b, comment = ""}
if (file.exists(file.path(out, "session.txt"))) cat(readLines(file.path(out, "session.txt")), sep = "\n")
```

```{r attach-b2}
p <- csv("packages.csv")
if (!is.null(p)) knitr::kable(p, col.names = c("Package", "Version"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## C. R CMD check

```{r attach-c, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(chk)) cat("Not run.") else {
  cat(sprintf("Status %s; %d errors, %d warnings, %d notes.\n\n", chk$status,
              length(chk$errors), length(chk$warnings), length(chk$notes)))
  for (x in c(chk$errors, chk$warnings, chk$notes)) cat("```\n", x, "\n```\n\n")
}
```

## D. The tests' log (testthat)

The whole suite's output is `test-log-all.txt`; its last lines:

```{r attach-d, comment = ""}
f <- file.path(out, "test-log-all.txt")
if (file.exists(f)) cat(utils::tail(readLines(f), 12), sep = "\n")
```

## E. Line coverage by file

```{r attach-e}
if (!is.null(cov)) knitr::kable(cov$files[order(cov$files$file), ],
                                col.names = c("File", "Lines", "Covered", "%"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## F. Exported functions and the tests that run them

```{r attach-f}
fn <- cov$fn_tests
if (!is.null(fn)) {
  direct <- unique(fn$alias[fn$direct %in% TRUE])
  n <- table(factor(fn$alias, levels = cov$exports))
  knitr::kable(data.frame(Function = names(n), Tests = as.integer(n),
                          Direct = ifelse(names(n) %in% direct, "yes", "")),
               row.names = FALSE)
}
```
